decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline fittings business in a growing market, it is inexpensive to continue offering while demand uncertainty is still resolving, though its weaker website prominence suggests somewhat higher exit risk than the others.
This bracket product builds directly on existing fabrication capabilities and customer needs, so the option value of keeping it on offer remains higher than its likely carrying cost.
This support bracket also fits the firm’s established custom metal offering and broadening strategy, making continued market presence a low-cost option worth retaining until clearer evidence emerges.
